mandatory_gates.name: benchmark authority and claim fit
mandatory_gates.required: active track manifest; at least two structurally distinct roots; structural/time holdout and template de-duplication; traceable scorer; ArtifactRole producer contract, recipient action, adoption, later assignment and independent Y, or PeerSelect auditable payoff; contamination/visibility mutation audit

mandatory_gates.name: executable baseline qualification
mandatory_gates.required: every required arm has versioned executable entry, sealed independent history, raw receipt and failure denominator; strong same-information control and closest faithful adapter qualified for full closure; retained NO-GO row limits claims

mandatory_gates.name: same-information and complete-cost parity
mandatory_gates.required: same legal read-cut fields, task/peer representation, encoder/checkpoint/schema, capacity, history digest, menu/version, tie-break, gate opportunity set, delay, exploration, service/model/API/tool/token/retry/state/queue budget and complete cost; post-gate coverage/UNKNOWN reported separately

mandatory_gates.name: matrix completeness and independence
mandatory_gates.required: manifest covers track/root/split, all arms, responsibility, drift/delay, independent streams, support/query or time holdout, minimum stream count and stopping receipt; no shared live memory, silent UNKNOWN or post-hoc split

mandatory_gates.name: result semantics and guide consistency
mandatory_gates.required: condition, endpoint and numerical gate sealed before execution; every cell classified favorable/neutral/adverse and falsifier run; ArtifactRole H2 requires future assignment to independent Y; absent Y is UNSTUDIED; hard-fail sentinels cover J permutation, trace-only, menu/version swap, recipient-only/mixed/UNKNOWN and unselected-label censoring

mandatory_gates.name: statistical and cost evidence
mandatory_gates.required: root/stream-aware uncertainty, ITT/all-attempt estimands, effect estimates, UNKNOWN worst-case bounds, failed/unstarted counts, full quality-cost/service accounting, and overlap/positivity or pre-registered randomized transport

mandatory_gates.name: reproducible closure receipt
mandatory_gates.required: source/data/scorer/prompt/model/config/hardware hashes, commands, raw outputs and summaries; independent environment/code path, blind scorer, policy-state masking, adversarial mutation replay and independent reviewer

closure_rule: CLOSED_FULL iff every mandatory gate B1-B7 appears exactly once and is PASS, the primary ArtifactRole future-assignment-to-independent-Y cells are complete, the required target cells are executed with known denominators, no unresolved protocol contradiction/leakage/unfair information/missing denominator remains, and the clean replay/independent-review receipt passes. This closure is independent of method_outcome: positive, neutral, or adverse completed results are allowed; insufficient or UNSTUDIED evidence keeps the gate OPEN. CLOSED_BOUNDED is not a benchmark acceptance status; bounded findings remain OPEN.
claim_rule: Gate CLOSED_FULL closes benchmark+baseline acceptance; it does not force a positive method result. A positive H2/H3 claim needs its own evidence. If the method is neutral/adverse against the strong control, report a bounded/null/negative/trade-off conclusion. If H1 is positive but H2 is neutral, support information value only; if H2 improves but H1 is not identified, the effect is confounded.
guide_alignment_definition: Applicable condition, endpoint and numerical gate sealed before execution; observed regime classified as favorable, neutral or adverse; falsifier and denominator checks run; every required cell reported.

readiness_levels.exploratory: Protocol/fixture/single-root or insufficient precision; no main scientific claim.
readiness_levels.findings_ready: Reproducible real result with at least one independent confirmation or strict controlled diagnostic, complete denominator/cost and bounded claim scope; positive or negative allowed.
readiness_levels.proceedings_ready: At least three structural roots, or a pre-registered precision-justified two-root design; multiple independent streams, unseen confirmation, strongest same-information and closest published treatment, full statistics/cost and clean replay.

status_matrix.OPEN: Any gate not PASS, missing/UNKNOWN/UNSTUDIED required cell, insufficient method outcome, or readiness below proceedings_ready; benchmark+baseline acceptance remains open.
status_matrix.CLOSED_FULL: All B1-B7 PASS, required cells complete, proceedings-ready evidence, clean replay and independent review; method_outcome may be positive, neutral, or adverse. Target cells must cover each pre-run root/stream/arm tuple and include H1/H2/H3/safety; the ArtifactRole H2 cells must carry known future-Y evidence.
status_matrix.FAIL: A hard-fail sentinel, leakage, unfair information, denominator contradiction, invalid root/stream, or failed reproducibility invalidates the acceptance attempt; preserve evidence and rerun only under a new pre-registered card.

bounded_status_rule: CLOSED_BOUNDED is prohibited for closure_scope=benchmark_baseline_acceptance; use readiness_level=findings_ready plus status=OPEN and bounded claim_scope.
real_api_requirement: A zero-call fixture may close only a protocol qualification subgate; benchmark+baseline acceptance requires real API evidence with raw response hashes, attempted/charged counts and post-stop call count.
history_semantics: Parity requires the same legal history opportunity/read-cut schema and public-input digest across arms; each adaptive arm retains an independent realized-history namespace and records its own history digest.
cross_field_checks: gates has exactly seven entries with unique IDs B1..B7; no duplicate can be signed
every root/stream/arm tuple in the pre-run stream manifest has a target cell with root_id, stream_id and arm_id
target cells include H1, H2, H3 and safety; ArtifactRole H2 has a known future Y with assignment and evidence digest
minimum_streams_per_arm is at least two and each arm meets it with independent history namespaces
each sentinel has executed=true, PASS status, reason and evidence digest
real API attempted/charged/successful and stop receipt counts agree; post-stop calls are zero
gate/cell/stream denominators reconcile arithmetically and complete-cost ledger is independently verified
estimate and interval are finite, ordered and contain the estimate
independent reviewer identity differs from all gate verifiers
